text: I don't understand...
zh: 我听不懂……

text: (Leave)
zh: （离开）

text: May I help you with something?
zh: 有什么我可以帮你的吗？

text: Do you understand me?
zh: 你能听懂我说的话吗？

text: Judging by your look, I'm interpreting that as yes.
zh: 从你的表情来看，我就当你是听懂了。

text: What was that book?
zh: 那本书是什么？

text: Why did you attack me?
zh: 你为什么攻击我？

text: Who are you? Or what?
zh: 你是谁？或者说，是什么东西？

text: Where is the city Dhul'oq?
zh: 杜尔奥克城在哪里？

text: What is in the next room?
zh: 隔壁房间里是什么？

text: Tell me about the sacred stones.
zh: 跟我说说圣石吧。

text: I found this Coin from Dhul'oq.
zh: 我找到了这枚杜尔奥克的硬币。

text: I would like to exchange the coins.
zh: 我想兑换硬币。

text: What do I do with a Pale Coin?
zh: 苍白硬币该怎么用？

text: I want to destroy a Pale Coin.
zh: 我想毁掉一枚苍白硬币。

text: Here are Pale Essences.
zh: 这是苍白精华。

text: (Leave)
zh: （离开）

text: It was a book of magical knowledge.
zh: 那是一本记载魔法知识的书。

text: This knowledge makes it possible to learn special skills.
zh: 这种知识能让人习得特殊的技能。

text: In this case, it enabled you to understand my language.
zh: 就你而言，它让你能听懂我的语言。

text: Why did you give the book to me?
zh: 你为什么把书给我？

text: Thanks...
zh: 谢谢……

text: How else are you supposed to understand the ancient language?
zh: 不然你要怎么听懂古老的语言呢？

text: There is nothing to thank me for.
zh: 不必谢我。

text: I am the keeper of the city Dhul'oq.
zh: 我是杜尔奥克城的守护者。

text: Before Dhul'oq's ascension, I was my master's servant.
zh: 在杜尔奥克升空之前，我是我主人的仆从。

text: But after his disappearance, I stayed here in his chambers and from then on I protected what was still to protect.
zh: 但在他失踪之后，我便留在他的居所里，从那时起守护着尚可守护之物。

text: Who was your master?
zh: 你的主人是谁？

text: You mentioned the Pale Ones.
zh: 你提到了苍白者。

text: I want to know something else...
zh: 我想问点别的……

text: My master was the high priest of Dhul'oq.
zh: 我的主人是杜尔奥克的大祭司。

text: Yes?
zh: 什么事？

text:
The city is high above your world.
High up in the sky...
zh:
这座城远在你们世界的上方。
高悬于天空之中……

text: Only the tower, the center of the former Dhul'oq, remains as the connection between us and the city.
zh: 唯有这座塔——昔日杜尔奥克的中心——仍是我们与那座城之间的连接。

text: But the Pale Ones corrupted him... us...
zh: 但苍白者腐化了他……也腐化了我们……

text: The Coins should not have been...
zh: 那些硬币本不该存在……

text: never...
zh: 永远不该……

text: NEVER!
zh: 永远不该！

text: The creators of the Pale Coins...
zh: 苍白硬币的创造者……

text:
We worshiped them.
They were supposed to break our limits and reshape our society.
zh:
我们曾崇拜他们。
他们本该打破我们的极限，重塑我们的社会。

text: That was exactly what they did. And along they caused our destruction.
zh: 他们确实做到了。可与此同时，也带来了我们的毁灭。

text: After the creation of the coins, the Pale Ones left us in our misery.
zh: 硬币铸成之后，苍白者便弃我们于苦难之中。

text:
My task is to defend.
I did not know your intentions, therefore I had to act.
zh:
我的职责是守卫。
我不知你来意如何，因此不得不出手。

text: However, I know when I have to admit defeat.
zh: 不过，我也知道何时该承认败北。

text:
But do not assume that everyone in this tower acts the same.
Most of us are already too corrupted to think clearly.
zh:
但不要以为这座塔里的所有存在都会像我一样行事。
我们大多数早已腐化过深，无法清醒思考。

text:
The portal to the sanctuary of Dhul'oq.
It is the only way to reach the city without knowing how to fly.
zh:
那是通往杜尔奥克圣所的传送门。
若不会飞行，那便是抵达那座城的唯一途径。

text: Read the ancient text of the tablet and I will tell you what I know.
zh: 读一读石板上的古老文字，我便告诉你我所知道的一切。

text: The three sacred stones - Nayryth, Ferumor and Erylding - were used to activate the portal to Dhul'oq.
zh: 三块圣石——奈里斯、费鲁莫尔与埃里尔丁——曾被用来启动通往杜尔奥克的传送门。

text: We deactivated the portal after the creation of the Pale Coins and gave the stones away.
zh: 苍白硬币铸成之后，我们关闭了传送门，并把圣石送了出去。

text: Where are the stones now?
zh: 圣石如今在哪里？

text: How can I activate the portal?
zh: 我要怎么启动传送门？

text: I want to know something else...
zh: 我想问点别的……

text: Yes?
zh: 什么事？

text: The stones, as well as the lords who received them, disappeared.
zh: 那些圣石，连同接受它们的领主们，都消失无踪了。

text: I can't tell you where they are now.
zh: 我无法告诉你它们如今身在何处。

text: Place the sacred stones where they once were, and the portal shall fulfill its purpose.
zh: 将圣石放回它们原来的位置，传送门自会履行它的使命。

text: Maybe, you will find such information inside this tower.
zh: 也许你能在这座塔里找到相关的线索。

text: A Pale Coin is able to greatly increase your power if you know how to use it.
zh: 若你懂得如何使用，一枚苍白硬币便能大大增强你的力量。

text: Though, with the current knowledge about the coins, I advise against the use of them.
zh: 不过，以目前对硬币的了解，我劝你不要使用它们。

text: How can I use the coin?
zh: 我要怎么使用硬币？

text: What should I do?
zh: 那我该怎么做？

text: That is all I wanted to know.
zh: 我想知道的就这些。

text: Too much destruction has already been caused by their sheer existence.
zh: 仅仅是它们的存在，就已造成了太多毁灭。

text: Be careful.
zh: 千万小心。

text: Unfortunately, I don't know the answer to that question.
zh: 很遗憾，这个问题我不知道答案。

text: Even if I knew, I wouldn't want to tell you.
zh: 即便知道，我也不愿告诉你。

text: You should destroy the Pale Coins, before further harm is caused.
zh: 你应该毁掉苍白硬币，以免造成更多伤害。

text: How can I destroy the Pale Coins?
zh: 我要怎么毁掉苍白硬币？

text: I don't think I will.
zh: 我看还是算了。

text:
Parts of their power also flows within my veins.
Therefore, I am able to remove their very essence and convert it into something else.
zh:
他们的部分力量也流淌在我的血脉之中。
因此，我能剥除硬币的本源精华，将其转化为别的东西。

text: That decision is up to you.
zh: 如何抉择，由你决定。

text: If you wish to destroy a coin, hand it over to me. I will render it useless to this world.
zh: 若你想毁掉一枚硬币，就把它交给我。我会让它于这个世界再无用处。

text: Are you sure?
zh: 你确定吗？

text: Yes. Destroy the coin.
zh: 是的。毁掉这枚硬币。

text: No.
zh: 不。

text: Well then, it surely is not an easy decision to make.
zh: 也罢，这确实不是个容易的决定。

text: So be it.
zh: 那便如此吧。

text:
So you found yourself a sacred stone already?
I must admit that this surprises me.
zh:
这么说，你已经找到了一块圣石？
我得承认，这让我颇为意外。

text: I remember reading a text about the sacred stone Nayryth shortly after the stone was given away.
zh: 我记得在圣石奈里斯被送走后不久，读到过一篇关于它的文字。

text:
It was one of our priests who delivered the stone to #:queen Heliria:#.
While I don't think she is still alive, the stone may have never left her side.
zh:
是我们的一位祭司将圣石送到了#:赫莉莉亚王后:#手中。
虽然我想她早已不在人世，但圣石也许从未离开过她的身边。

text: Surely you'll find the sacred stone where Heliria was buried.
zh: 在赫莉莉亚安葬之处，你定能找到那块圣石。

text: A while ago I came across a text about the sacred stone Ferumor.
zh: 前些时候，我读到过一篇关于圣石费鲁莫尔的文字。

text: They figured it'd be a wise choice to hide the stone deep inside the #:volcano:#, where it's heat would not cause any harm.
zh: 他们认为把圣石藏进#:火山:#深处是个明智的选择，那里的高热不会造成任何危害。

text: This information may help you in your quest to find the stones needed to access Dhul'oq.
zh: 这些信息或许能帮你找到进入杜尔奥克所需的圣石。

text: I wonder what happened to the people of #:Rhoga:#.
zh: 不知#:罗加:#的子民后来怎么样了。

text: The sacred stone Erylding had been given to them to keep the stone protected.
zh: 圣石埃里尔丁曾被交予他们保管守护。

text:
However, I remember the stone emitting a frightening aura.
Hopefully they knew how to safely seal the stone away.
zh:
不过，我记得那块圣石散发着令人恐惧的气息。
但愿他们知道如何将它安全封存。

text: This shall be your reward.
zh: 这是给你的报酬。

text:
A coin that was forgotten, like the city.
This coin has little value to you.
zh:
一枚被遗忘的硬币，就像那座城一样。
它对你来说没什么价值。

text: However, it reminds me of times when the world was not yet shaped by the Pale Ones.
zh: 但它让我想起那段世界尚未被苍白者塑造的岁月。

text: Bring me more of these coins, and I shall exchange my knowledge with you in return.
zh: 给我带来更多这样的硬币，我便以我的知识作为交换。

text:
Very well.
Take a look at my knowledge.
zh:
很好。
来看看我的知识吧。

text: *you are given a #:mysterious book:#.
zh: *你获得了一本#:神秘之书:#。

text:
I am starting to understand the Coins themselves.
They seem to be conduits for a greater power. The Pale Essence.
zh:
我开始理解这些硬币本身了。
它们似乎是某种更强大力量的导体。那便是苍白精华。

text:
I seek deeper knowledge of the essence.
Deliver the Pale Essences to me for my studies, and you shall be rewarded.
zh:
我想更深入地了解这种精华。
把苍白精华交给我供我研究，你自会得到报酬。

text:
Good!
How many do you have in  your possession?
zh:
很好！
你手上有多少份？

text: 1 Pale Essence.
zh: 1份苍白精华。

text: 5 Pale Essences.
zh: 5份苍白精华。

text: 10 Pale Essences.
zh: 10份苍白精华。

text: I've changed my mind.
zh: 我改主意了。

text: Here is your reward.
zh: 这是你的报酬。
